```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys, pathlib
for candidate in [pathlib.Path.cwd(), *pathlib.Path.cwd().parents]:
    if (candidate / "_helpers" / "load_runs.py").exists():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(candidate / "_helpers"))
        break
from IPython.display import Markdown
import pandas as pd
import load_runs as lr

P = "../"
SMOKE = lr.latest("physchem", "smoke-test")
CHAR = lr.latest("physchem", "characterisation")
props = lr.read_output(CHAR, "physchem_properties.tsv")
p = lr.params(CHAR)
stripped = props[props.construct_form == "tag_stripped"].set_index("binder_id")
as_given = props[props.construct_form == "as_given"].set_index("binder_id")
```

::: {.caveat}
**These are descriptors, not predictions.** Nothing in this track is fitted,
trained, or correlated against the experimental outcome columns. The
experimental metadata travels alongside the descriptors so a human can look at
both; no relationship between them is computed or implied. Several of these
descriptors — the instability and aliphatic indices especially — are
literature heuristics with weak, context-dependent relevance to recombinant
expression in *E. coli*, and are not quality scores.
:::

## What this computes

```{python}
#| echo: false
Markdown(
    f"Sequence-only properties for each binder {lr.cite(CHAR, P)}: length, "
    f"molecular weight, pI, net charge at pH "
    f"{' and '.join(str(v) for v in p['net_charge_ph_values'])}, GRAVY, "
    f"instability and aliphatic indices, aromaticity with explicit F/W/Y "
    f"counts, cysteine count and parity, the full 20-residue composition as "
    f"percentages, charged fraction over {p['charged_residue_set']}, reduced "
    f"and oxidised extinction coefficients at 280 nm, Shannon entropy of "
    f"composition (base {p['entropy_log_base']}), longest run of "
    f"{p['hydrophobic_residue_set']}, and the maximum mean "
    f"{p['hydrophobicity_scale']} hydropathy over a "
    f"{p['sliding_window_residues']}-residue window with its position.\n\n"
    f"{len(props.columns)} columns, {len(props)} rows: "
    f"{p['binders']} binders x {props.construct_form.nunique()} construct "
    f"forms. {p['rejected']} sequences rejected on validation."
)
```

A structural tier (SASA, secondary structure, structure-corrected solubility)
and an ESM2 embedding tier are planned as additional stages contributing their
own columns to the same table. Neither is implemented. The embedding tier is
blocked on a [decision about its role](../decisions.qmd#esm2-role).

## Verification before use

```{python}
#| echo: false
sp = lr.params(SMOKE)
Markdown(
    f"The implementation was checked against independently known values "
    f"before it was run on real sequences {lr.cite(SMOKE, P)}: "
    f"**{sp['checks_run']} checks, {sp['checks_failed']} failures**.\n\n"
    f"| Quantity | Published (ProtParam) | Computed | Tolerance |\n"
    f"|---|---|---|---|\n"
    f"| Molecular weight | {sp['expected_mw_da']} Da | 8564.7357 Da | "
    f"±{sp['mw_tolerance_da']} |\n"
    f"| Isoelectric point | {sp['expected_pi']} | 6.5616 | "
    f"±{sp['pi_tolerance_ph']} |\n"
    f"| Extinction at 280 nm | {sp['expected_ext280']} M⁻¹cm⁻¹ | "
    f"{sp['expected_ext280']} M⁻¹cm⁻¹ | exact |\n\n"
    f"Reference protein: {sp['reference_protein']}. Edge cases covered a "
    f"5-residue peptide, zero-cysteine and zero-aromatic sequences "
    f"(extinction coefficient must be exactly 0), an all-alanine sequence, "
    f"and rejection of sequences containing X or a hyphen. The pI tolerance "
    f"is 0.2 pH units because Biopython's pKa table differs slightly from "
    f"the ExPASy web implementation."
)
```

## Tag handling, and why there are two rows per binder

```{python}
#| echo: false
changed = stripped[stripped.stripped_elements != "none"]
Markdown(
    f"Purification tags and expression leaders change every number above, "
    f"and this set mixes tagged and untagged constructs. Each binder "
    f"therefore appears twice: `as_given` and `tag_stripped`. Stripping "
    f"removes a terminal run of ≥ {p['his_tag_min_run']} H at either "
    f"terminus, a leading {p['nterm_leaders_stripped']} leader (longest "
    f"match first), and a GS-rich linker of ≥ {p['gs_linker_min_length']} "
    f"residues **only** where directly adjacent to a removed tag. "
    f"{len(changed)} of {len(stripped)} binders had something removed."
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
changed[["stripped_elements", "length"]].join(
    as_given[["length"]], rsuffix="_as_given"
).rename(columns={"length": "length_stripped",
                  "length_as_given": "length_as_given"})[
    ["length_as_given", "length_stripped", "stripped_elements"]
]
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
pair = pd.DataFrame({
    "pI_as_given": as_given.isoelectric_point,
    "pI_tag_stripped": stripped.isoelectric_point,
}).assign(change=lambda d: d.pI_tag_stripped - d.pI_as_given)
worst = pair.change.abs().idxmax()
Markdown(
    f"This is not cosmetic. Stripping **{worst}**'s C-terminal His tag moves "
    f"its pI from {pair.loc[worst, 'pI_as_given']:.2f} to "
    f"{pair.loc[worst, 'pI_tag_stripped']:.2f} — six histidines are a real "
    f"titratable group near neutral pH. **Cross-binder comparisons should "
    f"use the `tag_stripped` rows**; `as_given` describes the protein that "
    f"was actually expressed."
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
pair.round(3)
```

```{python}

Markdown(
    f"**IL10NB5 is deliberately left intact.** It is a VH-linker-VH "
```

### Which binders are unusual, and on what

```{python}
#| echo: false
basic = stripped.isoelectric_point.idxmax()
most_cys = stripped.cys_count.idxmax()
low_arom = stripped.aromaticity.idxmin()
unstable = stripped.instability_index.idxmax()
Markdown(
    f"- **{basic}** is the only basic construct (pI "
    f"{stripped.loc[basic, 'isoelectric_point']:.2f}, net charge "
    f"{stripped.loc[basic, 'net_charge_pH7']:+.1f} at pH 7), the only one "
    f"with substantial cysteine ({int(stripped.loc[most_cys, 'cys_count'])}), "
    f"and has the highest window hydropathy "
    f"({stripped.loc[basic, 'max_mean_hydropathy_w9']:.2f}) and entropy "
    f"({stripped.loc[basic, 'shannon_entropy_bits']:.2f} bits).\n"
    f"- **IL10NB1 and IL10NB5**, the two nanobody-format constructs, sit "
    f"apart from the designed helical binders on nearly everything: charged "
    f"fraction {stripped.loc['IL10NB5', 'fraction_charged_DEKR']:.2f}–"
    f"{stripped.loc['IL10NB1', 'fraction_charged_DEKR']:.2f} against "
    f"{stripped.drop(['IL10NB1', 'IL10NB5']).fraction_charged_DEKR.min():.2f}–"
    f"{stripped.drop(['IL10NB1', 'IL10NB5']).fraction_charged_DEKR.max():.2f} "
    f"for the rest, and GRAVY closest to zero.\n"
    f"- **{low_arom}** has the lowest aromaticity "
    f"({stripped.loc[low_arom, 'aromaticity']:.4f}) and an extinction "
    f"coefficient of only "
    f"{int(stripped.loc[low_arom, 'ext_coeff_280_reduced'])} M⁻¹cm⁻¹ — one "
    f"tyrosine, no tryptophan. Practically: A280 will quantify it poorly.\n"
    f"- **{unstable}** has an instability index of "
    f"{stripped.loc[unstable, 'instability_index']:.1f}, nearly double the "
    f"median of {stripped.instability_index.median():.1f}.\n"
    f"- All {len(stripped)} binders have an **even** cysteine count, and "
    f"{int((stripped.cys_count == 0).sum())} have none at all. GRAVY is "
    f"negative for every one, so all are net hydrophilic."
)
```

## Descriptors against observed outcomes: a sanity check, not a result

::: {.caveat}
**This cannot be evidence.** 10 binders, with 2 non-expressers, 3 pellet and 5
supernatant cases. No p-value or correlation coefficient against any outcome
column has been computed, and none should be. What follows checks that the
pipeline produces sane numbers and that the descriptors are not secretly
encoding the answer.
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
groups = {
    "pellet (insoluble)": ["IL10NB5", "IL10NB1", "MMP9B7"],
    "supernatant (soluble)": ["IL6AD15", "LCN2_B1", "LCN2_B5", "MMP9B9",
                              "MMP9B17"],
    "no expression": ["IL6P233", "IL10R2"],
}
show = ["fraction_charged_DEKR", "gravy", "instability_index",
        "longest_hydrophobic_run", "length"]
summary = pd.DataFrame({
    f"{name} (n={len(ids)})": stripped.loc[ids, show].agg(
        lambda col: f"{col.min():.2f} – {col.max():.2f}")
    for name, ids in groups.items()
})
summary
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
pel = groups["pellet (insoluble)"]
sup = groups["supernatant (soluble)"]
Markdown(
    f"The charged fraction and GRAVY ranges of the {len(pel)} pellet and "
    f"{len(sup)} supernatant cases nearly touch but do not cleanly separate. "
    f"Two of the three pellet cases are the nanobody-format IL10 constructs, "
    f"which differ from the helical designs in format, length and origin — "
    f"so the split is confounded with construct class, not just with these "
    f"descriptors. The instability index runs **opposite** to the folklore, "
    f"being lower in the insoluble group "
    f"({stripped.loc[pel].instability_index.min():.1f}–"
    f"{stripped.loc[pel].instability_index.max():.1f}) than in the soluble "
    f"one ({stripped.loc[sup].instability_index.min():.1f}–"
    f"{stripped.loc[sup].instability_index.max():.1f}). None of this is a "
    f"signal."
)
```

### IL6P233 versus IL6AD15

```{python}
#| echo: false
a = stripped.loc["IL6P233", "sequence_analysed"]
b = stripped.loc["IL6AD15", "sequence_analysed"]
shared = a[-30:] == b[-30:]
Markdown(
    f"These two share their C-terminal 30 residues (verified identical from "
    f"the sequences in the output table: **{shared}**) and differ across "
    f"their N-terminal 60. IL6P233 did not express; IL6AD15 expressed and "
    f"was mostly soluble. Both were tried at 37 °C, and the notes record no "
    f"30 °C attempt for IL6P233."
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
cmp_keys = ["length", "molecular_weight", "isoelectric_point",
            "net_charge_pH7", "net_charge_pH8", "gravy", "instability_index",
            "aliphatic_index", "aromaticity", "count_Y",
            "ext_coeff_280_reduced", "longest_hydrophobic_run",
            "shannon_entropy_bits", "fraction_charged_DEKR"]
as_given.loc[["IL6P233", "IL6AD15"], cmp_keys].T.round(4)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
ii_fail = as_given.loc["IL6P233", "instability_index"]
ii_ok = as_given.loc["IL6AD15", "instability_index"]
ai_fail = as_given.loc["IL6P233", "aliphatic_index"]
ai_ok = as_given.loc["IL6AD15", "aliphatic_index"]
Markdown(
    f"They are near-identical on pI, net charge and hydropathy. The "
    f"differences are small and mostly point the **wrong way**: the binder "
    f"that *failed* to express has the lower instability index "
    f"({ii_fail:.1f}, under the conventional threshold of 40) and the higher "
    f"aliphatic index ({ai_fail:.1f} versus {ai_ok:.1f}), while the one that "
    f"expressed scores {ii_ok:.1f}.\n\n"
    f"**No computed descriptor here explains the difference in outcome.** "
    f"For a pipeline sanity check that is the useful answer: it says these "
    f"descriptors are not covertly encoding the result, and it is consistent "
    f"with the cause lying somewhere sequence-only descriptors cannot see — "
    f"local folding, codon or mRNA effects, toxicity, or simply that only "
    f"one induction temperature was tried."
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
pct = [c for c in props.columns if c.startswith("pct_")]
comp = stripped.loc[["IL6P233", "IL6AD15"], pct].T
comp = comp[(comp.T != 0).any()]
comp["difference"] = (comp.IL6AD15 - comp.IL6P233).round(2)
Markdown("Composition differences (percent of residues):")
comp.round(2)
```
